Single very large OR mixes the 'any of' symptoms with Dehydration signs and vitals; correct logically, but 'Dehydration' disorder is added as an extra trigger not stated as a separate criterion on the page.

rule_level_problems.rule: Urgent: diabetes with low or high fingerprick glucose
rule_level_problems.problem: Glucose >= 11.1 with symptoms branch not explicit (covered by rule 1). 'Blood glucose status' concept may be less apt than 'Blood glucose concentration'. No measure task for random fingerprick glucose.

summary: Symptom coverage of the red box is complete and thresholds (temp >=38, BP <90/60, pulse >=100, glucose <4, >=11.1 + ketones) are right. Most consequential gaps: check_for lacks temperature/BP/pulse and any random-glucose measure task, the glucose >=11.1-with-symptoms branch is only implicit, and glucose/pulse concept choices ('Blood glucose status', 'Pulse, function') are questionable. Outside table (BP>=140/90, BMI, WC aims) is largely unencoded.
